statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because NQ is in the regular weekend closure and no live one-way price path can be observed; Stress remains extreme from rates, energy and geopolitical risk.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the available evidence does not indicate a current Tail block, while weekend headline and eventual reopening-gap risk remain material.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while macro and geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: Nasdaq futures are closed for the weekend, so no current continuation, shallow-pullback or failed-retracement path can be verified. Friday’s 162,000 payroll gain, higher Treasury yields and weaker broad equities raise macro Stress, while semiconductor strength limits directional confirmation. Oil and U.S.-Iran escalation add reopening-gap risk.
